title: Utility Order for Entergy Louisiana, LLC, ex parte. — This Order reverses the Ruling on Motion for Subpoena for the Production of Documents issued by the Administrative Law Judge on July 10, 2026, denying the Motion for Subpoena in full; vacates the Subpoena for Production of Documents issued on July 10, 2026; and moots the Motion to Quash Subpoena filed on July 14, 2026.
